text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D after gains may have felt reassuring, but a gain relative to my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should use a consistent plan.","After my account fell substantially, I held every position without trading. I should reassess holdings based on their merits rather than avoid selling because admitting a mistake feels painful.","Frequent account checks can make ordinary random fluctuations feel like signals. Since past moves do not predict future prices, I should avoid reacting to them and trade only when my plan calls for it."]}
